FLUX_DEV.title: FLUX DEV
FLUX_DEV.description: Core models required for standard FLUX-DEV image generation.

Z-IMAGE.title: Z-Image
Z-IMAGE.description: Core models required to run Z-Image. Choose between the BASE and TURBO models

FLUX_REDUX.title: FLUX REDUX
FLUX_REDUX.description: Assets for image prompt guidance and style transfer.

QWEN_EDIT.title: QWEN EDIT
QWEN_EDIT.description: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 (int8). HD and Turbo (2511 Lightning 4-step LoRA) variants, shared by the 1-image Edit and 2-images Reference apps.

QWEN IMAGE 2.1.title: QWEN IMAGE 2.1
QWEN IMAGE 2.1.description: Qwen-Image-2.1 text-to-image: diffusion (base or turbo), qwen3vl-8b encoder, the t2i prompt-enhancer encoder (qwen3.5 9B) and the 2.1 VAE.

FLUX 2 KLEIN FAMILY.title: Flux 2 Klein family
FLUX 2 KLEIN FAMILY.description: Models for image generation the 4B, 9B models, base and distilled

QWEN IMAGE.title: QWEN IMAGE
QWEN IMAGE.description: QWEN IMAGE Image Generation. Versions initial and 2512, with lightning loras

KREA 2 TURBO.title: KREA 2 TURBO
KREA 2 TURBO.description: Krea 2 Turbo (int8) with the qwen3vl-4b text encoder, the Krea 2 VAE and the krea2 style-reference LoRA. Shared by the text-to-image and the style-reference apps.

Minimax FL2VA.title: Minimax H3 FL2VA
Minimax FL2VA.description: Minimax H3 FL2VA (first/last frame or text -> video + audio). Shared by the Text-to-Video and Image-to-Video apps: same diffusion model, different conditioning. Turbo adds the FL2V 8-step LoRA.

LTX-2.5.title: LTX-2.5
LTX-2.5.description: LTX-2.5 architecture, with distilled diffusion model and prompt enhancer

WAN22_T2V_14B.title: Wan 2.2 T2V 14B
WAN22_T2V_14B.description: Wan 2.2 Text to Video 14B (high + low noise). HD and Turbo (LightX2V 4-step LoRA) variants.

WAN22_I2V_14B.title: Wan 2.2 I2V 14B
WAN22_I2V_14B.description: Wan 2.2 Image to Video 14B (high + low noise). HD and Turbo (LightX2V 4-step LoRA) variants.

WAN22_FLF_14B.title: Wan 2.2 FLF 14B
WAN22_FLF_14B.description: Wan 2.2 First & Last Frame to Video 14B (uses the I2V high + low noise models). HD and Turbo (LightX2V 4-step LoRA) variants.

Minimax R2VA.title: Minimax H3 R2VA
Minimax R2VA.description: Minimax H3 R2VA (reference images / audio -> video + audio). Used by the Reference-to-Video and Multiframe apps (same model, different reference wiring). Turbo adds the R2V 4-step LoRA.

FLUX 2 KLEIN EDIT.title: Flux 2 Klein Edit family
FLUX 2 KLEIN EDIT.description: Klein edit models (4B and 9B, base and distilled) used by the Edit and 2-images Reference apps. 4B uses flux2-vae, 9B uses the small-decoder VAE, shipped once as flux2-vae_small.safetensors. No Fast LoRAs: the distilled models are separate checkpoints.

QWEN IMAGE 2.1 EDIT.title: Qwen Image 2.1 Edit
QWEN IMAGE 2.1 EDIT.description: Qwen-Image-2.1 edit models: diffusion (base or turbo), qwen3vl-8b encoder, the i2i prompt-enhancer encoder (qwen3.5 9B) and the 2.1 VAE.

FLUX KONTEXT.title: FLUX KONTEXT
FLUX KONTEXT.description: FLUX.1 Kontext dev (fp8) with the CLIP-L + T5-XXL text encoders and the FLUX VAE. Shared by the 1-image Edit app and the 2-images Reference app.

FLUX USO.title: FLUX USO
FLUX USO.description: FLUX.1-dev (fp8 checkpoint) plus the USO style-reference LoRA / projector and the SigLIP vision encoder. Used by the USO reference apps.

SDXL.title: SDXL
SDXL.description: SDXL checkpoints, one variant per model. Bring your own SDXL checkpoint with Custom.

FLUX 3 KLEIN.title: Flux 3 Image Klein family
FLUX 3 KLEIN.description: FLUX 3 Image Klein (5.6B) text-to-image. Klein Base is the undistilled checkpoint (50 steps, guidance 3.5) and the _sd_ file is the distilled one (16 steps, no guidance); both share the Qwen3-VL-4B encoder, the Qwen3.5-9B prompt upsampler and the FLUX 2 VAE.

FLUX 3 KLEIN EDIT.title: Flux 3 Image Klein Edit family
FLUX 3 KLEIN EDIT.description: FLUX 3 Image Klein (5.6B) for single-image editing and multi-image (reference) composition. Klein Base is the undistilled checkpoint and the _sd_ file is the distilled one; both share the Qwen3-VL-4B encoder, the Qwen3.5-9B prompt upsampler and the FLUX 2 VAE. The templates run guidance 1 for editing.

SEEDVR2 UPSCALE.title: SeedVR2 image upscale
SEEDVR2 UPSCALE.description: SeedVR2 7B int8 transformer and its EMA VAE: a one-step generative upscaler.

BIREFNET REMOVE BG.title: BiRefNet background removal
BIREFNET REMOVE BG.description: BiRefNet removes the background: the app writes the cut-out with alpha.

DEPTH ANYTHING 3.title: Depth Anything 3
DEPTH ANYTHING 3.description: Depth Anything 3 mono large: estimates a depth map from one image.

SDPOSE.title: SDPose whole-body
SDPOSE.description: SDPose-OOD draws a pose map: body, hands, face and feet.

UPSCALE MODELS.title: Upscale models
UPSCALE MODELS.description: The ESRGAN-family upscalers the Upscale with Model app offers. Install the one you want; they are alternatives, so any single file is enough.

SEEDVR2 VIDEO UPSCALE.title: SeedVR2 video upscale (3B)
SEEDVR2 VIDEO UPSCALE.description: SeedVR2 3B int8 transformer and its EMA VAE: the one-step generative video upscaler.

SAM3 SEGMENT.title: SAM3 video segmentation
SAM3 SEGMENT.description: SAM3.1 multiplex segments the video from a text prompt; the app writes the masks as images.

FRAME INTERPOLATION.title: Frame interpolation models
FRAME INTERPOLATION.description: The film net and RIFE interpolation models ComfyUI can load. They are alternatives - any single file is enough.

VIDEO INTERPOLATE UPSCALE.title: Video interpolate + upscale
VIDEO INTERPOLATE UPSCALE.description: Frame interpolation and an ESRGAN-family upscaler in one pass: needs one model of each kind.

MOSS.title: MOSS
MOSS.description: MOSS-Image (OpenMOSS): a ~5B single-stream DiT with the Qwen 3.5 text encoder and the FLUX.2 small VAE.
